notes: Ten independently generated pink-blue HBR-inspired harp bows. No user sketches were used. Variant 01 was edited using its own generated image to adjust the grip.

variants.name: 极光月弧
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE original HARP-BOW weapon from scratch, inspired by the refined Japanese anime science-fiction armaments of Heaven Burns Red (HBR). NO reference images are supplied or should be followed. Freely invent the silhouette, harp integration, armor and joints. This is one cohesive bow-musical-instrument hybrid, not separate objects.

Presentation: full-length isolated weapon, portrait 2:3, white background, refined colored anime game concept art, fine crisp contours, delicate cel shading, selective polished metal highlights. Complete upper and lower bowtips inside comfortable margins. No character, hands, arrow, quiver, labels, writing, watermark, multiple weapons or alternate states.

Palette: soft cherry-blossom pink and clear sky blue are the dominant colors, with small cool silver-white edges and modest blue-gray grip wrapping. Restrained pale-blue energy accents. No dominant purple, no gold, no red-black theme. Elegant and lightweight science-fiction design; coherent connections and tapered limbs.

Functional identity: one obvious MAIN bowstring, straight and taut between the two tips in an undrawn resting state. An accessible real handgrip is integrated into the solid riser. The center of the actual grippable handle must be horizontally level with the midpoint of the main bowstring. Do not draw alignment guides. Use musical strings integrated into the weapon, attached to visible supports, with a clear visual distinction from the main bowstring. Invent the musical-string arrangement freely according to the variant below; do not repeat a crude diagram or impose the same internal string layout on every design. Avoid clutter around the grip and finger clearance.
Unique design direction: A single uninterrupted slender crescent with pink outer enamel and sky-blue inner structural spine. A compact five-string harp follows the upper inner curve, with its lower bridge attached just above the centered grip. Smooth contours, tiny diamond energy lens, minimal joint detailing.
variants.edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this freshly generated pink-and-blue harp bow. Correct only the handgrip location and immediately adjoining riser pieces. The wrapped grip is currently centered around y=830 on this 1024x1536 image. Move the actual wrapped handgrip UP about 65 pixels, to center y=765. Move its small surrounding guard assembly up to match, and reconnect the riser and small musical bridge cleanly. Shorten the musical strings slightly where required. Keep the length of the wrapping the same; translate it, do not stretch it.
The main bowstring endpoints and both bowtip locations must stay fixed. The handgrip center must align HORIZONTALLY with the midpoint of the long primary bowstring. Keep white canvas, full composition, palette, slender outer limbs, individual design, all unrelated details and anime rendering unchanged. No guides, measurements, dots, text, person or added objects. Preserve the original full weapon silhouette as much as possible.
